parameters.name: LabelSelectorKey
parameters.description: 工作负载对应的标签，目前固定为`ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`。

parameters.name: LabelSelectorValue
parameters.description: 服务工作负载对应的Label标签：`ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`的取值。

parameters.name: ServicesList
parameters.description: 泳道关联的服务列表，取值为JSON数组，单个服务格式为`$集群名称/$集群ID/$Namespace/$serviceName`。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh create-swim-lane --service-mesh-id 00000 --swim-lane-name s3 --label-selector-key ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG --services-list sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mocka_,_sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mockb_,_sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mockc --label-selector-value v3 --group-name test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh CreateSwimLane --region cn-hangzhou --LabelSelectorKey ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG --GroupName test --ServiceMeshId 00000 --ServicesList 'sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mocka_,_sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mockb_,_sh01/c089443ea9e50403fa4f0a6237d11e0a9/default/mockc' --SwimLaneName s3 --LabelSelectorValue v3
